name: BeammWave AB (publ)
summary: BeammWave AB (publ) provides radio chips with antennas in Sweden, Japan, Taiwan, and South Korea. It builds a chip-based solution intended for next-generation 5G and 6G. The company’s products are used in various applications, including smartphones, CPE for fixed wireless access, and base stations. BeammWave AB (publ) was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Lund, Sweden.
